content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has issued Advertisement Number 16-Exam/2026 for the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET)-2026.

The online application and fee submission period was 03 August 2026 to 01 September 2026. The notification's first page gives 08 September 2026 as the last date for fee adjustment and application modification. Candidates should use the official UPSSSC portal and read the scanned advertisement before making any correction.

Important Dates

  • Advertisement date: 01 August 2026
  • Application / fee payment begins: 03 August 2026
  • Application / fee payment last date: 01 September 2026
  • Fee adjustment and application correction last date: 08 September 2026

About PET

UPSSSC PET is a qualifying examination used for shortlisting in applicable Group-C recruitment processes. The examination authority and official advertisement control eligibility, fee, exam schedule and subsequent recruitment conditions.
